_about: Trimmed from the committed src/subway/timetable/korail-k1-weekday.json at commit 7718b7c0 (its last change, 2026-10-18), 70 of its 336 trains in their order: each train whose time at a served platform falls from 50 minutes before (10 where no tracker tick is pinned) to 90 minutes after a pinned instant of its day type: weekday 08:00 (the tick), 00:20 and 02:00 KST; Saturday 14:00; public holiday 11:00, and 14:00 for the Korail and Shinbundang holiday tables, which serve Saturdays (move-reference-datasets task 9.1, design D14). The part schema strips this note.
